title: Freshdesk API Guide: Auth, Rate Limits, Webhooks and MCP (2026)
snippet:
The Freshdesk API is a REST API, version 2, that takes and returns plain JSON over HTTPS and authenticates with each agent's personal API key. Access starts on the Growth plan. The budget is counted per minute for the whole account: 100 calls on Growth, 400 on Pro and 700 on Enterprise, with 50 on every trial and none on the legacy Free program.[1] Webhooks fired by your own automations spend that same budget.

Freshdesk's pricing page lists Growth at $19 per agent per month billed annually ($228 per agent a year) and Pro at $55 per agent per month billed annually ($660 per agent a year). Billing is per agent and every agent sits on the same plan, as our [pricing guide](/articles/freshdesk-pricing) explains. By our arithmetic, on annual billing the step from 100 to 400 calls a minute costs $432 per agent a year ($2,160 for five agents, $4,320 for ten); billed monthly it is $43 per agent a month. Ask for an extra-calls quote before upgrading for the API alone.

### API Access Requires Paid Plan
Freshdesk's free (Sprout) plan has zero API access — 0 calls per minute. You need at least the Growth plan (200 calls/minute) to connect Freshdesk to [Zapier](https://integrationatlas.com/platforms/zapier/), [Make](https://integrationatlas.com/platforms/make/), [n8n](https://integrationatlas.com/platforms/n8n/),

Freshdesk enforces per-minute rate limits by plan: 200 calls/minute on Growth, 400 on Pro, and 700 on Enterprise — with no API access at all on the free plan.

title: Freshdesk Integrations: Slack, Jira, Salesforce, Shopify Setup
snippet:
The catch is the plan. Marketplace apps and the API start on Growth, with only the telephony extensions also running on the Free program. The Salesforce Connector runs on paid connector tasks,

Apart from the phone extensions, every connector here assumes a paid plan. Freshdesk's pricing page lists Growth at $23 per agent per month billed monthly, or $19 per agent per month billed annually ($228 per agent a year). Billing is per agent and every agent on an account sits on the same plan; the seat math is in our [Freshdesk pricing guide](/articles/freshdesk-pricing). New buyers get a 14-day trial with Enterprise features and no card, the right window to wire up apps, though the trial API allows 50 calls a minute and connector task packs need an active paid subscription. There is no self-serve free plan. Freshdesk can move a small account into its Free program (up to 2 agents) through Customer Success, without API access.

| Integration | Lowest Freshdesk plan | How it is billed |
|---|---|---|
| Slack (new app) | Growth | Free Marketplace app |
| Microsoft Teams | Growth | Free Marketplace app |
| Jira Plus | Growth | Marketplace app |
| Salesforce Connector | Growth | Paid connector tasks |
| Shopify | Growth | Marketplace app |
| Freshsales | Growth | Free Freshworks app |
| Zapier | Growth | Uses the API rate limit |

The newest route is MCP. Since 10 September 2026, Freshdesk's MCP server lets AI tools such as Claude, Cursor and Microsoft Copilot Studio read and update tickets, contacts and knowledge-base articles. Each user connects with their own API key, and every action respects that user's role permissions. Growth includes 100 actions a month, Pro 500 and Enterprise 1,000. Extra actions are sold in packs of 1,000 on the pricing page, and allowances do not roll over.
